criterion: Before any held-out evaluation, prefer mode with lowest mean stage validation NLL across the three seeds; lowest validation NLL seed within that mode is an exploratory representative, never a test-selected winner
tie_breaking: mode name lexicographic; seed ascending within mode
interpretation: Validation-only exploratory preference. Primary reporting includes both conditions and all six seeds/checkpoints. No test result influences this record.

analysis_protocol.bootstrap: paired, unstratified, percentile; sample clusters uniformly with replacement
analysis_protocol.cluster_estimand: image-weighted metric; all images of each sampled hash group travel together
analysis_protocol.internal_same_case_unit: prepared exact-pixel/dHash connected group; NOT patient identity
analysis_protocol.internal_same_case_interpretation: Exact-row-held-out comparison only; prepared similarity groups can contain old strict-train/validation rows
analysis_protocol.old_hash_group_unexposed_sensitivity: Prespecified secondary subset of unchanged primary: exclude every primary row whose prepared hash group contains any old strict train/val row; derive only from existing primary predictions; retain and report the full primary
analysis_protocol.clinical_unit: one source subject after the evaluator averages slice probabilities
analysis_protocol.clinical_interval: two-sided Clopper-Pearson for accuracy, AD sensitivity and CN specificity
analysis_protocol.paired_difference: candidate minus reference, using the same resampled cases/groups
analysis_protocol.macro_f1: fixed class vocabulary, zero division contributes zero
analysis_protocol.balanced_accuracy: mean class recall; undefined when a target class is absent
analysis_protocol.bootstrap_missing_class: omit undefined replicate only for that metric; suppress CI if <95% valid
analysis_protocol.decision_threshold: argmax in published class order; binary tie predicts CN
analysis_protocol.multiplicity: no adjusted significance testing; all candidates/readers reported, none selected here
analysis_protocol.reader_missingness: strict complete labels by default; explicit opt-in reports paired complete cases
analysis_protocol.primary_conditions: Report all three seeds per mode: arithmetic mean, sample SD and range of each metric; all six checkpoints remain visible
analysis_protocol.validation_preference: Before any held-out evaluation, prefer mode with lowest mean stage validation NLL across the three seeds; lowest validation NLL seed within that mode is an exploratory representative, never a test-selected winner
